$comment: The three finish tiers in the owner's words. multiplier applies to base (material + machine); adderInrPerPart applies per printed part. PLACEHOLDER numbers.

tiers.name: As-is
tiers.what: Peeled off the plate and sent as it came out. Supports, if any, are left on for you to remove.
tiers.for: You want it fast and cheap, or you like finishing things yourself.

tiers.name: Supports removed
tiers.what: Supports removed and the contact points clipped neatly. No sanding.
tiers.for: A clean part you can use straight away.

tiers.name: Processed
tiers.what: Supports removed, then sanded and prepared as well as the geometry allows. Layer lines softened; not painted.
tiers.for: Display pieces, gifts, anything you will hold up to the light.

surfaceCopy.band: Prices are estimates until the piece is sliced here; the final figure can move by up to {band} and you approve it before paying.
